scope: Read-only inspection of recorded sources and committed hypothetical exercise state
rules: Receipt must equal the bound session's current host query.
Known empty supplies do not form stock dependencies; unknown quantities remain conditional.
Only uncarried supplies in valid recorded home spaces form storage groups.
Sole location applies only to each category's recorded potentially nonempty inventory; it is not a claim about all household stock.
Access is host-computed; an unavailable item's cause is not inferred from its storage group.
Carried supplies use the current exercise carrier, with unknown carrying capacity.
Destination conditions are recorded evidence, never inferred activation or present availability.
No real facts, tasks, or scores change from dependency observations.
compatibility: Absent or null SimulationSession.dependencyPolicy preserves historical inspection kinds. New sessions use this version; resumed sessions preserve their source policy. Unknown policy versions fail decoding.
